message:
If you have ever lived above a shop in Delhi, this is your street's story.
For years many Delhi homes had a shutter below and the family above, without a clear rule, and traders feared sealing. On 15 September 2006 Delhi notified mixed land use on 2,183 roads in one go, and 355 more roads followed in April 2007. The Master Plan for Delhi 2021, notified in February 2007, allowed daily-needs shops, clinics, labs, banks, gyms and coaching centres in residential areas.
Does your street have a shop downstairs?
Educational content, not advice. Sources: Oneindia (8 Feb and 13 Apr 2007), DNA (8 Feb 2007), The Quint (2018). AI-generated imagery.
